subject: Heard about these 2 words that start meetings
preview_text: Right now is the perfect time to use one feature that changes everything.
body_paragraphs: You know that moment when a meeting ends and everyone just sits there, silent? Nobody remembers the key decisions. Action items vanish. It's chaos. I just heard from three founders in the last week who finally cracked this — they're using Smart Notes' one-tap recording on every call now, and it's saving them hours.

Right now, with Q4 planning and end-of-year reviews in full swing, your calendar is probably packed. Every meeting matters more. The difference between a productive week and a wasted one is literally a single tap. Users who start recording their first meeting on day one return far more consistently — because they never lose a key point again.

One feature you might have missed: the language-aware transcription. It automatically detects and transcribes in your meeting's language, even if your profile is set to something else. No switching settings. No second-guessing. Just clear, searchable text with structured summaries and action items ready to share.
Open Smart Notes now and record your next meeting with one tap. You'll leave with clarity, not confusion. P.S. The first summary you create might just be the most productive 30 seconds of your week.
